extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the BZT52C8V2 row was selected from the BZT52C2V0 through BZT52C75 electrical-characteristics table for manufacturer hongjiacheng.
The supplied PDF identity was verified as LCSC C19077406, MPN BZT52C8V2, manufacturer hongjiacheng, with SHA-256 1e58426ecb363e87dbad0da3e5a12350aadc7203342e2c339877f1de5b2d7631.
Zener reverse semantics are preserved: nominal VZ = 8.2 V is paired with the tabulated reverse test current IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT = 15 ohm is at IZT and maximum ZZK = 80 ohm is at IZK = 1 mA.

The BZT52C8V2 electrical-characteristics row gives inclusive VZ bounds of 7.79 V minimum and 8.61 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA, maximum reverse leakage IR = 0.7 microA at VR = 5.0 V, and admissible IZM = 5 mA, with TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.

The five zener-characteristic points are direct approximate graph-read observations from the visible BZT52C8V2 trace labeled 8.2 in p. 3 Fig. 1 at labeled logarithmic-current grid values; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no points were interpolated.

No component-specific capacitance or reverse-recovery-time specification is published in the supplied datasheet. The p. 3 capacitance and dynamic-impedance plots are family-level typical characteristics without a uniquely identified BZT52C8V2 trace and were not assigned component-specific points.
Maximum ratings include PD = 350 mW and forward voltage VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA on p. 1; junction and storage temperature limits are -55 to +150 degC and typical RthetaJ-A is 357 degC/W.
